pullRequest.body:
## Accepted product source, publication still separate

Reuse #304/#305 for the requested Homebrew delivery after Bamboo #1794/#1796 and the accepted stop-diagnostics companion. This is the existing shared paired-source slice; it does not expand into every optional-plugin feature in Zenith #375.

- Actual remote product head: `d8b0eb6cad98ec53afe8dc4f6aeaa35ef050ec9f`
- Product tree: `116eff816bc810e65e254d8051b0641a47e27cd1`
- Parent: `18e134cabb054a979da1b86ea794c5d557949185`, whose parent is0c367d08ec60f87fed8b292f89440bd2c7b7f930.
- Current accepted main: `81c176f8e399c985b16aa539be0ea29b13c986ec`. Recheck before normal merge; productMerge tree must equal accepted sourceTree.
- Fixed paired Bamboo source: `687f816c493c9c3a2785ca4cf6626e256339de85`, tree `90c7d930fb15adef2c70d6b89e737793d63d15a6`.
- Bamboo protected-history admission is complete: [PR1833](https://github.com/bigduu/Bamboo-agent/pull/1833#issuecomment-6116188721) normally merged as8911e07a3a22ae9e7f2f59119d17bbe210d39051, tree136cb5d07c39ad5ff64e6fda6db4fc408b92ae7b. Exact required Test/Windows passed; API and fetched Git objects prove687f ancestry and equal reviewed/tested integration trees. Integration8911 does not replace the fixed product pin or certify its separate full release gates.

## Bounded source changes

The four literal pins in ci.yml, realBambooRuntime.ts, published-real-bamboo-acceptance.test.mjs and docs/verification.md remain identical at687f. Accepted main includes #299, #300 and #309. The earlier84fe updates only stale Settings test contracts;0c aligns published-browser actions with actual empty/restored-tab state without OR fallback, skip, deadline or retry changes. These changes are retained byte-for-byte.

The final increment restores existing #281 / #282 source `5242eaf1d6e8cd8d437e8a4dcb82c63d00af82f1` as18e134 via clean cherry-pick-x with original author; the original nine-file +223/-28 diff is byte-identical. The old temporary #278 release branch is not merged. Currentd8 separately adds four test-file improvements (+125/-4), giving the complete PR17 files +495/-69. This now includes four production files; it is not described as a pure test-only PR.

Only a fully validated current bootstrap admission can grant the default-false owner context. Non-owner ordinary chat does not probe/poll owner-only Ticket scope; unavailable negotiation completes so ordinary Send can proceed. Owner revocation aborts reads, removes listeners/timers, advances epoch and prevents stale decision responses restoring current state. Backend authorization, permission models and Ticket403 handling are untouched.

The built-artifact regression now actually clicks Send for unauthenticated, local-bypass and authenticated contexts, retains the draft while ACK is pending, blocks duplicate submission, then checks one ordinary admission/execute and the visible acknowledged message. It preserves a rejecting403 boundary for accidental anonymous Ticket access, zero Ticket ingress and existing same-origin/WS/error assertions. Additional unit negatives cover revoked/readmitted access, late decision ACK/conflict/unknown outcomes, StrictMode and unknown bootstrap states.

## Current gates

- Cloud exactd8 npm verify exited0 on Node24.19.0:140 files /2757 unit tests, type/lint/i18n/architecture/build/package contents. Raw log SHA256 `b56e719ca4351c909131ba92a462136c0e35f3d6ea9e35e11e39ea531383d8cf`. Dist sourceDirty=false,710 resources, resources SHA256 `f76e0f8d54d566ac92ca9473544168de2074833d7f1a7191c1b83421995cb3a5`. Cloud Chromium failed to launch with socket EPERM; no local browser pass, bypass flag or installation is claimed.
- Ordinary PR checks: [38192299968](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38192299968), event pull_request, attempt1, headd8; Node22/24 passed and conditional Real skipped. Actual checkout/package source was synthetic `ee175d47a9566221ab054587c0868c387cdcea6a`, tree116eff identical to d8. This PR run does not substitute for exact-source release acceptance.
- Exactd8 [ci.yml dispatch38192328532](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38192328532), attempt1, was created at01:33:09Z after an empty exact-dispatch baseline; its single normal command exited0 with no inputs. Both Node22/job114627543611 and Node24/job114627543951 passed2757 unit and365 browser cases, with97 existing skips and no new retry. Each built the actual d8 source0.0.0 package with710 resources, digest `60ef877ef46416a049a79085e1306351b4e1f7ba96ba39a32c9a4c24104a8c5d`. Their raw logs are SHA256 `765e5c32afdbf8d3f54038af663a57ac7805ee266be57fc79d69069f50649390` and `16e64749512d32fbfb524d3d5994af5758ca969a4ff9b7be1d5d153a469a1123`. Real Bamboo/job114630686952 has now succeeded: original direct10 passed/3 mode-skips (including permission/Settings/MCP/Workflow Run), packaged local1 passed/2 mode-skips, packaged HTTPS/WSS1 passed/2 mode-skips covering desktop/tablet/phone/orientations. The exact same d8 local-pack identity was used on both surfaces. Raw log SHA256 `86b764fa5bee29656d5bc14ec86483929a4900e53c3b50e0eca8d6afb7ee90ff`. [Complete runtime artifact11723480779](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38192328532/artifacts/11723480779) is5,140,605B, verified SHA256 `fd3367e8a7bdc80afdc28f4d7454c34b4050b80f44aec0d3df1657811f9b4d3a`; source/image revision, actual local/remote artifact manifests and original screenshots were independently read.
- Full-delta independent current [Code review](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/pull/306#issuecomment-6116207915) and [Security review](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/pull/306#issuecomment-6116209480) found noP1/P2. These are relayed static reviews, not GitHub-native Approvals or runtime proofs.
- Current d8 source review/checks, full original runtime acceptance and Bamboo protected-history admission have passed. Fresh review lists have no unresolved threads or change requests. Normal product merge remains a separate action; after merged:true record the actual productMergeSha and verify exact tree equality. No synthetic pre-merge merge_commit_sha is treated as a product merge receipt.

## Exact687f / d8 macOS source pair

The original normal Tokio/Inspector/cold-restart flow passed with native and browser exit0, original browser1/1, zero retries, unchanged240s suite/270s owner bounds. Complete archive16,072,058B, SHA256 `86332a81f571c352f2f43e34c977c107cd8b9effe162120b04807a1a668055e9`; all77 manifest entries, original raw Cargo/native/browser/trace and three1440×900 screenshots were independently checked. Inspector remains aligned before/after Refresh.

There are17 actual browser-v2 responses matching the wire attachment (5running/running,12succeeded/stopped), four Actor frames and unchanged Child/activation/attempt/null-placement identity. Cold reopen preserves stopped observed_at; original history responses before/after restart retain the same single Child answer ID. Both actual Hosts were killed and waited by the fixture owner; there was no outer forced cleanup/fallback/timeout. The source-paired Mac dist is actual d8,710 resources with digest60ef877e above. Original compiler provenance and current pre/post-run rehashes prove reuse of the same687f CLI/fixture; this run invoked no Cargo. It does not relabel the laterF23a9 test cache or claim an embedded/Homebrew-installed package.

The independent archive cannot rehash omitted binary/full-dist bytes directly; complete on-Mac binary/dist verification is supported by its saved execution records, manifest verifier and original compiler/argv chain. This is source runtime evidence, not npm publication or a new full matrix.

## Preserved0c failure

[Exact0c dispatch38187476216](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38187476216), attempt1, FAILED and is not publishable. Node22/24 each passed2736 unit and356 browser cases with97 existing skips. Real job114615937539 passed direct10/3 mode-skips and packaged-local1/2 mode-skips, then HTTPSdesktop failed on two GET/api/v1/tickets/scope403 responses. Later remote phases did not run. Raw log SHA256 `0c033ffd5ced97ed8c24b2d54db7702472d766fb0bcf7d30b6e7a213c994f313`; [retained artifact](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38187476216/artifacts/11721063151), ZIP SHA256 `0f489546ff5600cb85b333c475ffcffad0119ae2e7297e75d116df40b976fe48`.

The actual browser bootstrap was open/unauthenticated on remote.lotus.test, with no owner credential. The backend correctly returned scope_denied. TLS/same-origin/loopback port mapping is not owner authority; the harness's separately captured127.0.0.1 local_bypass bootstrap was not that browser context. Original#281 was previously merged only into obsolete#278, not current main; d8 recovers that existing fix instead of swallowing403, forging owner headers or changing backend access. [Source recovery and evidence](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/issues/281#issuecomment-6116114045).

## Preserved failures and partial evidence

[Exact5dc dispatch38183601948](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38183601948) FAILED and is not publishable. Node22/24 each passed2736 unit and356 browser cases with97 existing skips. Real job114604077080 passed10 direct runtime cases with3 mode skips, including the original permission/Settings repairs. Packaged local passed desktop, then failed tablet at the empty-entry versus restored-tab action; local1 failed/2 mode skips, HTTPS stage not executed. [Original artifact, hashes and diagnosis](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/pull/306#issuecomment-6115402525). No same-head blind retry or partial-success acceptance was substituted.

The earlier5a20 [dispatch38149958435](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/actions/runs/38149958435) failed4 stale Settings cases plus a genuine permission-event path. Its [failure receipt](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/pull/306#issuecomment-6110833400) and [84fe test-only repair receipt](https://github.com/bigduu/lotus-next/pull/306#issuecomment-6110996823) remain. Backend #1826/#1825/#1815 and frontend #309 have their separate implementation evidence; final real UI acceptance is still required.

The Mac 687f/5dc normal Tokio/Inspector/restart flow reported native/browser exit 0 and 1/1 browser case with zero retries; its complete 15,706,122-byte archive (SHA256 9e49044219ad02d99f7d4f2f0159ff6e8b091d2adcba0cb8b007c2ce01c7eb09), all 87 manifest entries and three original screenshots have now been independently verified. It retains its actual source identity. The new d8 increment changes Root/bootstrap owner admission and requires a fresh exact-source pair. The original actor-runtime suite is unchanged, but the older5dc dist and its digest do not certify d8.

## Publication boundary

After original exact-source acceptance and a normal same-tree product merge, #305 uses a separate reviewed control PR with actual run/jobs/merged-PR evidence, an unused strict version and the exact annotated source-tag object. Historical candidates remain intact. Source package manifests stay0.0.0; existing publication workflow supplies release identity.

The #299 dynamic publication Bamboo binding remains derived from the accepted run-bound candidate. Downstream Bamboo #1810 and consumers use independently verified registry bytes. Existing Lotus server protection was not verified: basic main metadata reports protected:false and rulesets are empty; this work still follows the full existing review/CI/normal-PR contract without changing security settings.

Unix stop evidence covers the managed process group and registered resources. Real panic-through-browser and a same-execution three-resource combined scenario remain unclaimed layered-coverage limits, not newly added release gates.
